title: Oxva Xlim 3 Ultra Pod Vape Kit
description: TThe OXVA XLIM 3 Ultra Pod Vape Kit introduces a full touch screen and enhanced performance to its celebrated flagship XLIM pod kit series, and pairs a 1500mAh built-in battery with that super-crisp 2.2-inch HD touch screen for intuitive control and customisation. Supporting up to 30W of adjustable output, it is designed for both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping. Smart Wattage Control automatically adjusts power to the coil in use, helping ensure consistent performance. The Super Pulse System and UniTech 2.0 chipset work together to stabilise output and extend pod lifespan, giving you a reliable vape across charges. Side airflow control allows you to fine-tune the draw, while both auto-draw and button activation are supported for everyday convenience. The screen also offers custom themes, animations and a lock function to prevent accidental firing. The XLIM 3 Ultra is supplied with two refillable XLIM V3 top-fill pods : a 0.6ohm pod for RDL vaping with lower strength e-liquids, and a 0.8ohm pod suited to Nic Salts and higher strength 50/50 blends. It is also compatible with the wider XLIM pod family, including earlier V1 and V2 pods, and EZ pods . With USB-C 2A charging that restores 80% battery in just 30 minutes, the XLIM 3 Ultra is a capable and adaptable pod vape kit. Match your kit with a vape liquid uk designed to complement every puff. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
